data.title: Identity: kadence is a company; 'no server, no account, no network' stays a property of the kadence CLI and its format, and a paid org view may be hosted
data.why: The owner's call on 2026-10-21, made with DEC-64's reasoning in front of him: the switch to a company happens now rather than on E2 passing or an accelerator offer. What carries over unchanged from DEC-64: the CLI, its file format and its hooks never require a server, an account or a network, never phone home, and no core feature moves behind a paid line; a paid org view is a separate opt-in product that may be hosted and says so wherever it is offered. What does not change either: the evidence gates of DEC-63. Being a company changes who kadence is for, not what is known; hosted code still waits for E2 and G1 > 0 (KAD-106, KAD-112), and the risk DEC-64 named, a hosted product eating outreach hours, is held by those gates, not by identity.
data.rejected: Reputation project with a pre-set switch (DEC-64): the owner chose to commit now instead of waiting for E2 or an offer; the accelerator applications already present kadence as a company; Company, and drop the evidence gates so the hosted org view starts now: G1 is 0 and E1 is unrun; the gates are what keep a solo founder's hours on outreach
